description: From an owner or an admin: make the draft a new public version. Every file is drawn again and published at cdn.ideare.app/b/<slug>/v<n>/; follow the run to see it finish. From anyone else: ask the owner to approve this draft, which they do in one tap. Send the draftRev you looked at. Costs no credits.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this call. Send the SAME one again after a lost answer to get the first answer back, with nothing spent twice.
